name: Yoshino Soyo
source: She has the same last name and a similar appearance to a character from a vn made by the same studio, [url=/v3755]PurexCure[/url]. This character is [url=/c9164]Yoshino Mizuki[/url], and she is also the Poster girl of the same tavern, just like this character. It must be some kind of a reference, or Soyo and Mizuki might be related somehow.
